node.title: Selected mismatches have canonical full-external-zero charts
node.statement: For one deterministically selected exact-A witness/codeword per retained slope, let q_z be its nonzero difference codeword and Z_z all zeros of q_z outside the recovered discrepancy support T. The full locator P_Z divides q_z, |Z_z|<=K-1, and after division the scaled line on T has agreement at least A-|Z_z| with a code of dimension K-|Z_z|. Hence excess remains at least A-K. This gives one full-zero chart per selected slope/codeword and removes witness-subset spray, but does not bound the number of distinct charts.
